target: iPhone 18 Pro iOS 27.0 Simulator, Release SparklingGo; no native keyboard overlay launch flag
scope: Three recorded cold relaunches show an actual visible zero-inset-to-corrected jump. This is not merely an unverified earliest frame. No physical-device or universal host claim.
method: Every original video frame was decoded with passthrough timestamps. Full sequences inspected in contact sheets; key before/after frames read at full resolution. All261 PNG pixels independently matched ffmpeg rgb24 framemd5.
timing: VFR: r_frame_rate=600/1 is not a600fps capture rate. Exact per-frame ffprobe PTS retained; no inference of unseen frames or absolute presentation time.
decodingNote: First two image2 extractions warned about timestamp rounding; all frame counts and independent RGB24 MD5 comparisons passed. Third used -enc_time_base demux.
